body:
OK, so it's a random sunday, the night I had just broke up with my girl friend. I look on my desk after taking a shower and recovering from the past night's experience, and see that I have 2 pretty little baggies of 50 mg each of what was then my favorite drug. Right before I take this wonder drug, I remember how awesome it was the first 3 times I did it with my friends. I also remember that the previous night a few of my friends tried it again without me and supposably had no major results. Naturally, I came to the conclusion that they had just built up a tolerance to my DPT, because there's no way my baby could just fail to effect any of 3 people all at once. Me, being the genious that I am decided to raise my dosage by 40 milligrams, and to hit it hard and fast, so I get the full effect.
Anyways, I don't even bother to empty the bags in fear that I will lose some from stickage to the snorting surface. So I just say 'fuck it' and one whole baggy in one hit. My nose starts bleeding within 10 seconds, the burning is fucking horryfying. So I figure there's no turning back now and I just grab the other baggy and hit that shit again. I hit that so hard that both my ears popped. I swear that I started to become totally unable to function properly within 2 minutes. It was a fucking awesome feeling; but really different from anything else I've felt before(P.S. :I'm a very experienced and pretty knowledgable drug user; who's done enough different things for 10 lifetimes).
I liked the feeling so much that I ripped open the baggies and licked out all the residue. Then I realized that about half of the DPT hadn't dropped down my nasal pasageway yet; so I gave one quick, hard snort.... Bam! It all started....
I fainted onto my bed, and while it felt like I was out for at least an hour, considering how many crazy dreams I had. I was out for about 3 minutes and 30 seconds. I lied in bed for about a minute for a nice moment of clarity. Then I stood up, HOLY SHIT! Everything in my room was all mixed together; the colors, the shapes, everything! I stumbled around my room for a couple minutes and eventually found my door and went to get some food.
On my way there I realize something! Each of those baggies had a 100 mg in them. OH SHIT!
I have to focus. I take a minute...
So I go to sitdown in my chair in my room, only to fall face first on my front lawn! Yah! I was in for a long day! I stumble back into the house laughing at my idiotic behavior. I go to look at he clock and see that only about 15 minutes has passed since I took it. So, I go to lie down on my bed, I now can't make out the difference between the ceiling, floor, and walls. I begin to enjoy the insanity for a few minutes. BUT, then my stomach starts making sounds like it's some sort of dying animal; it feels that way too. I rush to the bathroom and lean over the toilet to throwup(it was actually my TV!). I threw up like no man has thrown up before(my record would be broken in a few hours); what did i throwup you ask? BLOOD! Blood and this really thick bright white foam(not a hallucination). This scares the living shit out of me and I call my friend but can't form a sentence.
I then passed out on the floor with all sorts of fucked up hallucinations around me. They were scary as fuck and I was afraid for my life. Then, I went blind! Yes, that right! All I could see for the next half-hour was a bright white light. I was crying the whole time! I thought I had died. I was completely incapacitated. It was the scariest moment I'd had in my life. I woke up later lying down behind my garage. I stand up and stumble my way around the garage only to see a bunch of police on the other side(they're real; but they were there because my downstairs neighbor reported that there was a rabid racoon in a tree above my garage, 'Crazy bitch, I'm the one that's suppose to be tripping here'). Luckily they didn't see me, as I somehow managed to stumble/sneak by them and enter my house.
The next 2 hours involved what was probably by far the hardest tripping of my entire life. But, I didn't go blind, throw up blood, or do anything perform anything totally out of the ordinary; so it doesn't seem worth mentioning. Just good hard tripping, while being too horrified to move in fear that I'd do something else detrimental to my little universe. Well needless to say, I got up to take a piss...
When I entered the bathroom the entire room seemed completely foreign to me. Like I had never seen it before or used it before. It was freaking me out and I vomitted again. Yah, it was more blood; no white foam though, the DPT was 'soaked in'. Anyways I called everyone I knew telling them all sorts of crazy shit in my little gibberish language. After which I went wondering around my house and ended up sitting on my porch. That's when I heard a knock at my door( the police); I itmediately jumped off my porch and fell 2 1/2 stories and was miraculously ok. I then ran to my truck and sped off to my friends house where I awakened with some shots of 151.
THE END
Moral of the Story: DAMN THIS SHIT IS FUCKED UP
SYMBOLISM: ME= A FUCKING IDIOT
